body.prompt: Create a versatile Card component using CSS Modules (.module.css) and semantic HTML (<article>, <header>, <footer>). MUST use named export 'export const Card: React.FC<CardProps> = ...'. MUST define TypeScript interface 'CardProps' containing ': string' (title: string;) and ': React.ReactNode' (children: React.ReactNode;) props. The root <article> element MUST include an explicit role="region" attribute and an aria-label attribute. MUST include keyboard accessibility with tabIndex={0} and an onKeyDown handler on the root element. MUST NOT use inline styles such as style={{...}}. MUST NOT use Tailwind. Include image, subtitle, hover elevation, optional badge, and loading skeleton state.
